decisions.reason: Specialized naval lighting has long qualification cycles and low keeping costs, so the option remains valuable while uncertainty resolves.
The desk lamp faces competitive consumer markets but its dedicated page shows commitment, and keeping the option open is still inexpensive.
The general interior luminaire is actively promoted as newly arrived, so it is kept while market response is assessed.
The pendant luminaire has only a website mention, indicating lower commitment, but the cost to keep the option open is low.
The marine HMI searchlight is specialized and high-value with long sales cycles, so the option is kept open.
The marine searchlight overlaps with other marine options but remains cheap to keep while demand is uncertain.
